targets.recordKey: New row; primary key Gen_allowedinformationforfundId = Guid.NewGuid generated by 'Create system columns' (main.vb:36). No existing record is targeted.
targets.writeCondition: One INSERT per row of 'Get Agent Or Agency Detail From Fund' (OLE DB Source DTSX:1965, SqlCommand DTSX:1970-2084) that (1) leaves Lookup 'Lookup' through No Match (DTSX:2137; full cache of SELECT * FROM [dbo].[Gen_allowedinformationforfundBase]; keys AGENT_NAME=Gen_agentname, AGENCY_NAME=Gen_agencyname, CONTACT_NAME=Gen_contactname, ACCOUNT_NAME=Gen_accountname, FUND_GUID=Gen_fundname - i.e. no existing row with that 5-key combination; POW_MAIN and IS_COMMISSION_AGENT are NOT keys) and (2) leaves Lookup 'filtering customers dead' through No Match (DTSX:1906; CONTACT_NAME = ContactId of a Contact with gen_customeragename = N'נפטר' - deceased customers are excluded). Source rows: UNION ALL of the two active (uncommented) branches over gen_fundmain JOIN gen_customeraccount (gen_customeraccountid = gen_fundmain.gen_customeraccountname) JOIN gen_powerofattorney (gen_customeraccount = gen_customeraccountid) with WHERE ((Gen_existinfile = 1) OR (gen_fundmain.gen_revaluationdate not null AND year(gen_revaluationdate) >= year(getdate())-3)) AND gen_powerofattorney.gen_currentstate = 1 (DTSX:2033-2053); branch 2 (DTSX:2055-2083) additionally joins the fund's broker contract ac1 (Gen_agentcontractId = gen_fundmain.gen_brokernumber) to its parent contract ac2 (ac2.Gen_agentcontractid = ac1.gen_agencycontractnumber) and requires (poa.Gen_agentname = gen_fundmain.gen_agentname OR poa.Gen_agencyname = gen_fundmain.gen_agencyname) AND ac1.Gen_isContractDataSharing = 1. Then ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY FUND_NUMBER, CONTACT_NAME, ACCOUNT_NAME, AGENT_NAME, AGENCY_NAME ORDER BY POW_START_DATE DESC) and only RowNum = 1 is kept (DTSX:1973, 2084): the POA with the latest Gen_startdate per combination; ties are not deterministic. Two older branches (agents with contract and no POA) are commented out (DTSX:1984-2032). Runs after 'Get systemuser organisationname and curency' (Success) and before 'Delete Rows' (Success).
targets.expression: Inserted unchanged (guid). NULL when the left join finds nothing.

notes.note: CRM DB proof: every writer uses Package.ConnectionManagers[CRM] (DTSID {EC67FF20-F4F6-4879-B546-653C1AF02333}, DTSX:4), ConnectionString Data Source=Psql; Initial Catalog=ALTSHULER_MSCRM (DTSX:6). All four business writes are direct SQL on CRM tables (Unsupported). The package has no business SDK write; its SDK writes (Create ETL Process record, End ETL Process record\ETL Record Finish -> gen_etlprocess) are ETL plumbing and are not mapped.

Execution order (precedence, all Success): Get Organization Variables -> Create ETL Process record -> Get systemuser organisationname and curency -> Create Fund View Table (INSERT) -> Delete Rows (2 DELETE commands) -> Execute SQL Task (DELETE) -> End ETL Process record. No executable or component is disabled.

Key mismatch between insert and delete: the insert dedup Lookup ('Lookup', DTSX:2137) uses 5 keys (agent, agency, contact, account, fund) while 'Check if valid allow' (DTSX:2225) uses 6 keys (adds POW_MAIN). When the latest active POA of an existing combination changes, the INSERT is skipped (5-key match on the old row) and 'Delete Rows' then deletes the old row (6-key no match), so the combination is missing until the next run inserts it again. IS_COMMISSION_AGENT (gen_agentreceivescommissionnly) is in neither key: a later change of that POA flag is never propagated to an existing row.

The insert-side Lookup reads the target table itself (full cache loaded before inserts), so it deduplicates only against rows that existed before this run; within one run duplicates are prevented only by the ROW_NUMBER partition (FUND_NUMBER, CONTACT_NAME, ACCOUNT_NAME, AGENT_NAME, AGENCY_NAME), which uses FUND_NUMBER while the table/Lookup key uses FUND_GUID.

Destination input mapping (DTSX:628-643) has 16 columns. Not written: Gen_name (primary name), OwnerIdType, OverriddenCreatedOn, ImportSequenceNumber, CreatedOnBehalfBy, ModifiedOnBehalfBy, TimeZoneRuleVersionNumber, UTCConversionTimeZoneCode. Script outputs TransactionCurrencyId, ParticipatesInWorkflow, CustomerSizeCode, Merged, ExchangeRate, DeletionStateCode, CreditOnHold, BusinessTypeCode, IsPrivate, TerritoryCode, OrganizationId are computed by 'Create system columns' but not mapped to the destination, so they are not written to CRM.
Script source is analysed (VB.NET main.vb embedded in the DTSX); the compiled binary is not decompiled.
